subject: reasoning
question:
In this question, three statements are given, followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusion(s) logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All paintings are good.

Some good things are exported.

Some exported things are costly.

**Conclusions:**

I. All paintings are exported.

II. Some paintings are costly.

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II follows.
Both conclusions I and II follow.
